node.statement: Operator estimates: def-compressed-corner gives ||E-L_R R_Q||=O(delta'+epsilon) and ||F-L_P R_Q||=O(delta'+epsilon). For ||X||=1, the product norm axiom and node 1.1 give ||(L_R R_Q-L_P R_Q)(X)||=||(R-P)(XQ)||<=(1+epsilon)^2||R-P||||Q||<=C_3 e. The triangle inequality therefore gives ||E-F||<=C_0 e; also ||E||<=||L_R R_Q||+O(e)<=(1+epsilon)^2||R||||Q||+O(e)<=M_0, for universal C_0,M_0 and a universal smallness threshold.
